summary.text: Lyndon Yearick has represented the 34th District in the Delaware House of Representatives since 2014 and served as House Minority Whip during the 152nd General Assembly.

paragraphs.text: Yearick was raised on a dairy farm in upstate Pennsylvania and has business experience in housing, banking, healthcare and education, and as a former small business owner.
Yearick holds a B.S. in Business Administration from Bloomsburg University and an MBA from Penn State University.
